fields.name: affiliation
fields.description: The id of the affiliation in the affiliations register.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The id of the source in the source register that the affiliation rests on.

fields.name: snippet
fields.description: The words of the source that support the affiliation, verbatim from its excerpt; empty when no quote was verified. A source with several such passages is cited once per passage.

fields.name: supersedes
fields.description: For the citation of a decision: the ids of the earlier decisions that this one overrules. Several values are separated by semicolons.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free-text remarks: what the source shows, in our words, and quotes not verified in its excerpt. A row from the migration to citations keeps the words of the old cell that cited the source, after `cited as: `.
